- `ClassCastException`: This exception is thrown if the class of the specified element prevents it from being added to the list. - `NullPointerException`: This exception is thrown if the specified element is `null` and the list does not permit `null` elements. - `IllegalArgumentException`: This exception is thrown if some property of the element prevents it from being added to the list. The code does not perform any checks that would prevent an `IllegalArgumentException` from being thrown, so this exception is not avoided.
